description: Go chat service api + worker roles: gRPC, Mongo chat_db, Redis streams. service.name = chat-service | chat-worker. Metrics :9091/:9099.

pages.name: Chats
pages.description: gRPC RED per role, DocDB ops, Redis streams lag

rawConfiguration.text:
## Chats (`chat-service` api + `chat-worker`, `${environment}`)
Known gap: Go services log `otel_service` but traces may be absent until SDK init lands — metrics (`:9091/:9099/metrics` via collector prometheus) and logs work today. Roles split by `service.name` facet. Datastores: `chat_db` Mongo (mode `standalone` on Floci), chat Redis streams. Degraded mode = `NoopStream` Mongo fallback.

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Metric SELECT rate(sum(chat_grpc_requests_total), 1 minute) AS `req/min` WHERE service.name = 'chat-service' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}'
FROM Metric SELECT (sum(chat_grpc_errors_total) / (sum(chat_grpc_requests_total) + 1)) * 100 AS `error %` WHERE service.name = 'chat-service' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}'
FROM Metric SELECT rate(sum(chat_worker_consumed_total), 1 minute) AS `consumed/min` WHERE service.name = 'chat-worker' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}'
FROM Metric SELECT max(chat_redis_degraded) AS degraded WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND service.name IN ('chat-service', 'chat-worker')

FROM Span SELECT percentile(duration.ms, 50, 95, 99) WHERE service.name IN ('chat-service', 'chat-worker') AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' FACET service.name, name TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 12
FROM Metric SELECT average(chat_grpc_duration_ms) AS `avg ms` WHERE service.name = 'chat-service' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' FACET grpc_method TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 10

FROM Metric SELECT rate(sum(chat_stream_produced_total), 1 minute) AS `produced/min`, rate(sum(chat_worker_consumed_total), 1 minute) AS `consumed/min` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' TIMESERIES AUTO
FROM Metric SELECT max(chat_stream_pending) AS pending WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' TIMESERIES AUTO

FROM Span SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) AS rpm, average(duration.ms) AS `avg ms`, percentile(duration.ms, 95) AS `p95 ms` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND service.name IN ('chat-service', 'chat-worker') AND (`db.system` = 'mongodb' OR name LIKE '%mongo%') FACET name LIMIT 20

FROM Span SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) AS rpm, average(duration.ms) AS `avg ms` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND service.name IN ('chat-service', 'chat-worker') AND (name LIKE '%redis%' OR name LIKE '%stream%' OR name LIKE '%cache%') FACET name LIMIT 20

FROM Log SELECT count(*) AS n, latest(message) AS sample WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND service.name IN ('chat-service', 'chat-worker') AND (message LIKE '%TLS%' OR message LIKE '%tls%' OR message LIKE '%AUTH%' OR message LIKE '%connect%fail%' OR message LIKE '%degraded%') FACET service.name LIMIT 15
FROM Metric SELECT average(go_goroutines) AS goroutines WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND service.name IN ('chat-service', 'chat-worker') FACET service.name TIMESERIES AUTO
